# Liquid Glass Design

Curated by Skill Harbor: a design skill for building iOS 26 interfaces in Apple's Liquid Glass language. Liquid Glass is a dynamic material that blurs what sits behind it, reflects surrounding color and light, and reacts to touch and pointer input. The skill covers the SwiftUI patterns first (the one-line glassEffect with regular variant and capsule shape, then tinting, interactive mode, and rect or circle shapes), glass button styles, morphing transitions between glass elements, UIKit integration for existing codebases, and WidgetKit for glassy widgets. It also addresses migration: how to move older blur and material effects onto the new API without visual regressions. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: design guidance only, no components to install; strictly iOS 26 and later, older OS versions cannot render it; Apple refines these APIs between releases, so verify against the current SDK docs before shipping. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
